'''Matt Sato''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 2nd at [[August 2000 Centerville tournament]] on 26 August 2000 with [[Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|Hidden Base/Our Most Desperate Hour]], according to Frank Lamantia's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1164">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-27-centerville-ohio-8-26-00d1164/ centerville-ohio-8-26-00], DeckTech (Frank "FrankLamanti" Lamantia, 27 August 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-27-centerville-ohio-8-26-00d1164/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
